grammarFocus: 一般现在时；I / you / we / they 的实义动词；时间表达与频率词入门。
title: My Weekday Routine
instructions: 阅读下面的短文，然后回答问题。所有题目都是单选题或填空题。填空题的答案必须与短文中的单词完全一致。本材料为模拟教学材料，不是官方雅思考试。
passage:
A. I am Li Hua. I am a student. I get up at six thirty. I have breakfast at seven. I go to school at seven thirty. I walk to school.

B. I have four classes in the morning. I have two classes in the afternoon. I like English. I have English on Monday and Wednesday. I have lunch at twelve. I go home at five.

C. I do my homework at seven in the evening. I go to bed at ten. On Saturday, I play football with my friends. We are happy.

questions.explanation: 短文第一段说“I get up at six thirty.”，所以起床时间是六点半。
questions.evidence: I get up at six thirty.

questions.explanation: 短文第一段说“I walk to school.”，walk 是“走路”，所以是步行去学校。
短文第二段说“I have four classes in the morning.”，所以上午有四节课。
questions.evidence: I have four classes in the morning.

questions.explanation: 短文第二段说“I have lunch at twelve.”，所以午饭时间是十二点。
短文第二段说“I have English on Monday and Wednesday.”，所以是星期一和星期三。
questions.evidence: I have English on Monday and Wednesday.

questions.prompt: 请用英文单词填空：李华下午有 ______ 节课。
questions.explanation: 短文第二段说“I have two classes in the afternoon.”，所以下午有两节课。
questions.evidence: I have two classes in the afternoon.

questions.explanation: 短文第三段说“I do my homework at seven in the evening.”，所以晚上七点做作业。
questions.evidence: I do my homework at seven in the evening.

options: He plays football with his friends.
answers: He plays football with his friends.
questions.explanation: 短文第三段说“On Saturday, I play football with my friends.”，所以星期六他和朋友踢足球。
questions.evidence: On Saturday, I play football with my friends.

grammar.title: 一般现在时：I / you / we / they 的实义动词
grammar.explanation: 一般现在时表示经常发生的动作或习惯。当主语是 I、you、we、they 时，动词用原形，不需要加 -s。例如：I get up at six thirty. 主语是 I，动词 get 用原形。
grammar.example: I get up at six thirty.

questions.explanation: 主语是 I，动词用原形 get，所以“I get up at six.”正确。
questions.evidence: I get up at six thirty.

questions.explanation: 主语是 we，动词用原形 like，所以“We like English.”正确。
主语是 they，动词用原形 play，所以“They play football.”正确。
questions.evidence: I play football with my friends.

questions.explanation: 主语是 you，动词用原形 have，所以“You have lunch at twelve.”正确。
